label: Delete account
intent: The account is deleted: it goes in the bin. Light: the bin's lid flips open on its left-hand hinge, the person tips toward the open bin, and the lid slams shut with a hit and a small rebound; the bin jolts and the person snaps back upright. Strong: the lid winds down, flips open wider and slams twice, the bin jolts on each slam, and the person tips further and rocks back in two beats before it settles.

shoulders.//: the set's person; the right shoulder stops short of the bin

body.//: the trash bin at badge size

bin.//: the whole bin jolts when the lid slams

lid.//: hinged at its left-hand end, away from the person; negative turns lift the right end

person.//: tips about the foot of the shoulders; positive leans toward the bin
